translation.text: And he swore by his great name that from now on he would not do this to all those who live on dry land. And he caused a sign to circle in heaven: “Let there be faithfulness between me and them forever, for the duration of the days of heaven upon earth; and this is by my command.”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected Ethiopic uses a verb of causing to go round for the sign in heaven; it does not name the kind of sign. “Faithfulness” renders ሃይማኖት, whose primary lexical range includes trust and the good faith of a relationship; a pledge is another contextual way of expressing that relation, but the selected word is not the technical noun for a covenant. The duration clause retains መጠነ, “measure/extent,” with the days of heaven upon earth, without adding a new conjunction. The text shifts from third-person narration to first-person “me” and “my”; quotation marks are editorial presentation. The selected starred form ማእከሌሆሙ is retained without silently normalizing its letters. The broad critical bracket begun at 54:7 closes after this unit. Six spaced printed dots follow that bracket before 55:3; these are editorial source signs, not authorization to invent missing wording or to add a new opening bracket at 55:1.
